name: Gifts
overview: Scripture reveals that all good and perfect gifts originate from God, the unchanging Father of lights, who graciously bestows them according to His sovereign will. Believers receive the gift of the Holy Spirit upon repentance and baptism, highlighting the spiritual nature of God's gifts. These gifts are given without regret or change, and through them, God calls and equips each person uniquely, urging humility and sober self-assessment. Salvation itself is described as a gift of God, received by grace through faith, underscoring the unmerited favor that characterizes all divine blessings.
